Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting language service providers from the definition of employment and worker for the purposes of unemployment compensation and industrial insurance.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting language service providers from thedefinition of employment and worker for the purposes of unemploymentcompensation and industrial insurance; adding a new section to chapter50.04 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 51.08 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 50.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The term "employment" shall not include services performed by aninterpreter or translator under a written contract with a languageservice provider for a specific engagement when the interpreter ortranslator performs no other duties for the language service providerand is not regularly and continuously employed by the language serviceprovider.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 51.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A person is not a "worker" for the purposes of this title, withrespect to his or her activities performed as an interpreter ortranslator under a written contract with a language service provider p. 1 SB 5771when the interpreter or translator performs no other duties for thelanguage service provider and is not regularly and continuouslyemployed by the language service provider.
